Writing the project charter and defining scope
Integrating sections from three authors into one consistent proposal
Producing professional documents and presentation visuals

members.name: Armaan

Competitive benchmarking against other drone and UAS programs

quality.name: Accuracy
quality.text: Each owner verifies the factual content introduced in their area.

quality.name: Citation integrity
quality.text: Every external claim must be recoverable to a source; unsupported claims must be re-researched, labeled as proposals, or removed.

quality.name: Presentation readiness
quality.text: All active members understand the whole proposal well enough to answer questions outside their primary section.
